scope: Offline attribution of the complete V8 sampling windows of one diagnostic live session, not release acceptance or a process CPU benchmark.

cpuThrottle.scope: openProbe and after-open counters precede CPU throttling; subsequent netplay setup and first game callback use the configured per-side rates.

method.units: Sample weights are raw V8 timeDeltas in microseconds. They include descheduling and profiler perturbation; no sample is discarded and no CPU-time claim is made.
method.partition: Each sample belongs to exactly one entire-profile source category. Within AudioDevice::pump, each sample belongs to one pump group; within its ma_node_graph_read_pcm_frames or ma_node_read_pcm_frames descendants, each sample belongs to one mix group. Partition sums are asserted.
method.precedence: Mix groups use ancestor membership: Vorbis/codebook/IMDCT, then WAV, then resampler/filter, then channel/data converter, then data-source/decoder, then node/engine/mix residue. A descendant of a group is charged only once.
method.inclusive: Subtree anchors are unions of matching ancestors per sample, preventing recursion/name aggregation double-counting. Different anchors overlap and must not be added.
method.inlining: WAV includes read/interface/metadata and inlined conversion, not just u8/s16 conversion. Linear resampler includes inlined filter work. No separate biquad/lpf/u8-to-f32/s16-to-f32 share is inferred without symbols.
method.diagnostics: Named clock/probe/network leaf candidates are retained, not subtracted. now/send names also serve runtime/product work. Audio-output, transport, live-counter and 500us V8 sampling probes are enabled; their causal overhead is not isolated.
method.window: Profiler starts/stops sequentially for each side after netplay setup and around formal polling. Complete profile windows differ by side and include more than report.summary frames 180..899. No recorded mapping from CDP profile timestamps to browser performance.now permits exact per-callback alignment.
method.counterContext: Native counters span before-open through final capture, which differs from the profile window. Their inclusive phases overlap and must not be summed. Startup/diagnostic checks can be present in cumulative counters even when the formal summary has zero replay.
method.limits: One 900-frame tape, one selected BGM, no impaired relay delivery, profile build with diagnostics. This cannot accept release smoothness, attribute earlier 2s RAF gaps, establish every music boundary, or measure PCM-cache/SIMD gains.

host.scope: Read-only host CPU counters and candidate process CPU counters. No performance samples are excluded or reweighted.
limitations: Aggregate CPU occupancy does not establish single-core availability, CPU frequency, thermal state, GPU load, or a stable benchmark environment.
Process names are candidates for contention, not proof that a process is compiling. Known harness/relay/helper PIDs are labeled separately; other node processes remain unlabeled candidates.
Process CPU is cumulative lifetime CPU seconds. A first sighting is not CPU consumed during this run; PID reuse or counter reset can break a delta.
The 5 s process snapshots miss short tasks that start and exit between snapshots. Timer delays and source/receive times are retained.
This observer has overhead. Its own PowerShell helper is intentionally not a candidate process, but its work is included in aggregate CPU counters.
Overflow and sampling failures make this evidence incomplete; they are never a reason to silently remove a game result.
host.caveat: Host sampling spans setup and report extraction as well as profiles. Process filtering and finite sample cadence cannot prove host isolation or assign a stall to another process.

currentMusicAssets.scope: Current fixture metadata read after capture; the raw live report does not record the selected music cue or music asset hashes.
